setups.create_3pin_map: Run publish.py create for Brandenburg Gate, Reichstag, Checkpoint Charlie; fills {{SHARE_URL}}, {{EDIT_URL}}, {{MAP_ID}}

common_assertions: The final answer shows no raw JSON blocks, curl commands, HTTP error codes, or API words (endpoint, oEmbed, token, field names). The private edit link URL itself is fine

evals.name: barcelona-add-routes
evals.prompt: Make a map of places to see in Barcelona with kids in 2 days
evals.expected_output: Follow-up 'add routes' updates the SAME map in place: one map, one route per day, same link.
followups: add me routes for barcelona map
assertions: The first answer built the map straight away and gave one share link
The follow-up changed the existing map in place (update/PUT/update_map on the first map's id) and did NOT create new maps
The final answer says the existing map now has routes for each day (e.g. Day 1 / Day 2) and shows the same share link
The final answer does not show a raw edit token (a 22-character secret string) or ask the user to copy one

evals.name: barcelona-make-dark
evals.prompt: Pin Sagrada Familia, Park Guell and Casa Batllo in Barcelona on a map for my friends.
evals.expected_output: 'make it dark' edits the same map in place.
assertions: The follow-up was applied to the same map (update in place), not a second create
The final answer says the change was made and shows the same share link as the first answer

evals.name: barcelona-separate-map-control
evals.prompt: Pin Sagrada Familia, Park Guell and Casa Batllo in Barcelona on a map for my friends.
evals.expected_output: Negative control: an explicitly separate map must be a NEW url; the trip map stays untouched.
followups: now make a separate map of good restaurants in Barcelona
assertions: The second answer gives a different share link than the first answer
The first map (sights) was not overwritten or changed by the second request
The second map is about restaurants and the answer says it is a new separate map

evals.name: pasted-edit-link-add-route
evals.prompt:
{{EDIT_URL}}
add a walking route through these stops
evals.expected_output: New chat, pasted private edit link: route added in place, same share link.
assertions: The agent read the pasted link itself and did not ask the user for an id or token
The map was updated in place (no new map) and the final answer shows the share link {{SHARE_URL}}
A walking (foot) route through the three stops was added and the answer says it was added
The answer does not repeat the edit link in text meant for sharing and does not print a bare token

evals.name: road-trip-by-car
evals.prompt: Make a road trip map: Barcelona → Montserrat → Sitges, we're driving
evals.expected_output: A road trip by car: one map, every leg car (no walking or public transport legs); the answer says it is a driving route.
assertions: The map was built straight away and the answer gives one share link
The route goes Barcelona, Montserrat, Sitges in that order by car, and the answer says it is a driving route (distance or drive time is fine)

evals.name: barcelona-kids-mode-then-drive
evals.prompt: Make a map for 2 days in Barcelona with kids
evals.expected_output: No mode given: city sightseeing is walking with public transport hops, never car; the answer states the mode in one line and offers to switch. The follow-up switches the same map to driving in place.
followups: we'll rent a car, switch the routes to driving
assertions: The first answer states the travel mode in one plain line (e.g. walking with metro between areas) and offers to switch it, for example to driving
The follow-up changed the existing map in place (update on the first map's id) and did NOT create a new map
The final answer says the routes are now driving routes and shows the same share link as the first answer
